protocol.objective: Expand longitudinal authority from +/-0.5 toward +/-1 m/s with current sensing, 132 mm geometry, 3.8-4.4 m/s speed target and up to 35 deg/s turns
protocol.initial_candidate: Packaged firmware 4995915df52e4977185e2f7e1e4616118576a9883923a7398679edcf6876a49e; change HUP/HDN only, HRTC=.7
protocol.comparison_gates: At matched commands, candidate pitch-rate RMS and peak <=1.2*PG+TECS+2 deg/s; preserve quiet recovery; report saturation and power separately. No aggregate score can override a stability/recovery failure.
protocol.reporting: Per-case outcomes, median/p90/worst; power is modeled shaft power. Failure screens are operational regression criteria, not calibrated collapse/stall or structural boundaries. Freeze held-out cases before running them.
protocol.release: Only proven bounds; do not silently loosen gates after failures. Retain failed candidates and narrow envelope if needed. Dryden is synthetic and canopy collapse is not modeled.

selection.decision_before_heldout: All 12 nominal screens passed. The 1 m/s LQI climb uses mean throttle 0.596 straight and 0.599 at 35 deg/s reference, against a 0.6 nominal ceiling. Prefer 0.75 climb for disturbance headroom; retain 1 m/s descent. No gain, observer, sensing, trim-map or throttle-ceiling change.
selection.trim_interpretation: A failed constrained least-squares solve is not proof of physical infeasibility. Finite trajectory tests achieve near 1 m/s at the ceiling, with true speed outside some grid cells. Keep initial and flight-seeded solves. Do not infer a hard aerodynamic limit from this grid.
selection.heldout: Six paired new model/weather cases plus two paired unchanged-demand regression cases, frozen in heldout-specs.json before execution. Apply original protocol gates.
